test_objective: Check that you can modify an attribute instance in temporal representation of an entity
keywords: Delete Intitial Temporal Representation Of Entity
teardown: Delete Intitial Temporal Representation Of Entity

test_cases.name: 016_01_01 Modify attribute instance in temporal representation of an entity
test_cases.doc: Check that you can partially update an attribute instance of a temporal representation of an entity
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Create Or Update Temporal Representation Of Entity Selecting Content Type with Response Status Code set to 201     and
        Modify Attribute Instance From Temporal Entity with Response Status Code set to 204     and
        Retrieve Temporal Representation Of Entity with Check Updated Entity and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to '${None}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'POST'
        Create or Update Temporal Representation of Entity Selecting Content Type: and
    Query Parameter: temporal_entity_representation_id set to '${temporal_entity_representation_id}' and
    Query Parameter: filename set to 'vehicle-temporal-representation-sample.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to '${EMPTY}'
}
